```{r}
#| label: fig-bilirubin-cat
#| fig-cap: "Bilirubin vs. categorical variables"
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| fig-subcap:
#| - Mitral regurg
#| - Tricuspid regurg
#| - RV function
#| - TAPSE > vs <= median
#| - Inf vena cava resp dimension
#| - Inf vena cava resp variation
#| - Hepatic dysfunction
#| - Pulm rales
#| - Periph edema
#| - Dyspnea at rest
#| - Otrhopnea
#| - Jug ven pulse
#| - NYHA class
#| - Clinical profile
#| layout-ncol: 4
#| layout-nrow: 4

boxfunc <- function(var, name) {
  levs <- str_replace(levels(escdata %>% pull(!!sym(var))), ">=", "\u2265")
  nlevs <- length(levs)

  p <- ggplot(escdata %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(var))), aes(y = Bili_mgdL, x = !!sym(var), fill = !!sym(var))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.75) +
    geom_violin(trim = TRUE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = global_cols[1:(nlevs + 2)]) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = "lightgrey",
        linewidth = 0.5,
        linetype = 2
      ),
      text = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(y = "Bilirubin (mg/dL)", x = name) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = levs)

  if (output) {
    create_pptx(p)
  }
  p
}
boxfunc(var = "OPMITREG_cat", name = "Mitral regurgitation")
boxfunc(var = "OPTRICUS_cat", name = "Tricuspid regurgitation")
boxfunc(var = "OPRVF", name = "RV function")
boxfunc(var = "OPTAPSE_cat", name = "TAPSE (mm)")
boxfunc(var = "OPIVDIM", name = "Inferior vena cava dimension")
boxfunc(var = "OPINFVAR", name = "Inferior vena cava respiratory variation")
boxfunc(var = "DMHDYS", name = "Hepatic dysfunction")
boxfunc(var = "OPPULRA", name = "Pulmonary rales")
boxfunc(var = "OPPULOE", name = "Peripheral oedema")
boxfunc(var = "OPDYSP", name = "Dyspnea at rest")
boxfunc(var = "OPORTHO", name = "Orthopnea")
boxfunc(var = "OPJVP", name = "Jugular Venous Pulse")
boxfunc(var = "OPNYHA", name = "NYHA class")
boxfunc(var = "OPCPRO", name = "Clinical Profiles")
```
